topic: Data aggregation discrepancy in facility sessions
summary_markdown: Someone ran a script to aggregate data for specific clusters, but noticed that the resulting dataset (`device_session_agg_5`) only contained those specified clusters. All other facilities belonging to the same company were missing from this aggregated view, even though they were present in another related dataset (`device_session_agg_ml_2`).
action_items: Investigate why certain facilities are excluded from the `device_session_agg_5` aggregation.
